data:
{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

data:
{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

data:
{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn

data:
{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

data:
{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

data:
{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

}

  header

{"operationName":"cartGet","variables":{},"query":"query cartGet {
  cartGet {
    ...CartInputFragment
    __typename
  }
}

fragment CartInputFragment on FormattedCartInput {
  cardinalJWT
  cartId
  cartCookieValue
  currency
  items {
    ...CartItemInputFragment
    __typename
  }
  quantity
  allItemsOOS
  anyItemCountryRestricted
  hasBackOrderedItem
  hasMarketplaceItem
  hasStoreShipRestrictedItem
  isGift
  isOnlyEGC
  uiAddressId
  __typename
}

fragment CartItemInputFragment on FormattedItemInput {
  crt_id
  index
  productCode
  quantity
  sku_id
  isOutOfStock
  isStorePickupEligible
  shipmentId
  storeId
  pickUpDay
  baseProductCode
  personalization {
    monogramStyle
    monogramLocation
    monogramText
    monogramThreadColor
    monogramType
    personalizeType
    __typename
  }
  giftCardDetails {
    giftMessage1
    giftMessage2
    price
    recipientEmail
    recipientName
    senderName
    type
    sentDate
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}
"}

  accountUser(loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue) {
    ...AccountUserFragment
    __typename
  }
}

fragment AccountUserFragment on AccountUser {
  id
  firstName
  lastName
  email
  role
  encryptedUserId
  guestUserId
  customerNum
  loyaltyPlusValue
  loyaltyPlusDetails {
    tierName
    nextTier
    extCustomerId
    balance
    couponsCost
    isJCCCHolder
    coupons {
      ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      __typename
    }
    offers {
      ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  userDetails {
    anonUser
    passwordHint
    email
    userFirstName
    userLastName
    emailSignup
    countryCode
    fromCookie
    birthDate
    id
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
  id
  expiration
  displayName
  cost
  __typename
}

fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
  id
  displayName
  code
  expiration
  birthdayOffer
  offerType
  title
  header
  activeOn
  __typename
}
"}

  cardinalJWT
  cartId
  cartCookieValue
  currency
  items {
    ...CartItemInputFragment
    __typename
  }
  quantity

  anyItemCountryRestricted

}

  crt_id

    giftMessage1

    type
    sentDate
    __typename
  }

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}

{"operationName":"accountUser","query":"query accountUser($loyaltyPlusValue: String) {
  accountUser (loyaltyPlusValue: $loyaltyPlusValue){
    userDetails {
      anonUser
      passwordHint
      email
      phone
      userFirstName
      userLastName
      emailSignup
      smsOptIn
      countryCode
      fromCookie
      birthDate
      id
    }
    omnitureVars
    loyaltyPlusValue
    loyaltyPlusDetails {
      tierName
      nextTier
      extCustomerId
      balance
      couponsCost
      pointsExpDate
      isJCCCHolder
      mobilePhone
      birthdate
      coupons {
        ...LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment
      }
      offers {
        ...LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment
      }
    }

    cart
    cartSize
    showIntlSignup
    customerCookieName
    requestFromJCrewNetwork
    birthdayDay
    birthdayMonth
    prefStoreId
  }
}
  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusCouponsFragment on LoyaltyPlusCoupons {
    id
    expiration
    displayName
    cost
  }

  
  fragment LoyaltyPlusOffersFragment on LoyaltyPlusOffers {
    id
    displayName
    code
    expiration
    birthdayOffer
    offerType
    title
    header
    activeOn
  }

","variables":{"loyaltyPlusValue":null}}
